declarations.description:
The promo code field of a checkout (Shopify, Uber Eats, Amazon): type a code, apply it, see it accepted or refused,
and keep each applied code as a removable token with its saving.

The app checks codes through `validate`, an async function that answers `{ code, label }` for an accepted code or
`{ error }` for a refused one; while it runs the field is read-only and the Apply button runs. Without `validate`
every code is accepted. `codes` holds the applied codes (set it to restore them), `max` how many may apply (1 by
default; at the limit the field gives way to the tokens), and `collapsed` starts it as an "Add a promo code" link.
Codes are upper-cased unless `case-sensitive`, and a code already applied is refused without asking the server.

Enter applies. Accepting and removing a code is announced; a refusal shows under the field, which it describes.

members.name: max
members.description: How many codes may apply at once. 0 means no limit.

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Starts as an "Add a promo code" link that opens the field.

members.name: caseSensitive
members.description: Keeps the case the reader typed instead of upper-casing codes.

members.name: label
members.description: The field's accessible name and placeholder. Default: "Promo code".

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the field, the Apply button and the tokens' remove buttons off.

members.name: validate
members.description: Checks a code with the app's server; see the class description. Without it every code is accepted.

members.name: room
members.description: Whether another code may still apply.

members.name: apply
members.description: Applies the typed code, as the Apply button and Enter do.

members.name: stopInner
members.description: The field's own `input`, `change` and field enrolment are not the component's.

events.name: apply
events.description: Fired when a code was accepted. Does not bubble.

events.name: reject
events.description: Fired when a code was refused. Does not bubble.

events.name: remove
events.description: Fired when the reader removed an applied code. Does not bubble.
